Shoulder coverage from X-cluster analysis of the garment's top 6% body-height band.

Scrub_Pants and cargo_pants are shape-indistinguishable (confirmed by eye on garment-class-sheet.png, f073dce8); their scrub/street split is a KIT/LICENCE provenance claim, not a geometric one. A mapping brief that ever chooses trousers by class must name BOTH columns. Recorded 2026-08-18 after the orchestrator graded the gate sheet; superagent ruled this is a note, not a vocabulary split.
